transcript.message: Mining stone and ore near mountains, anyone want to trade?
Mining here peacefully; open to trading ore later.

Mining ore here; will trade ore for food/water once I have surplus.
Gathering wood at 12,12, happy to trade fiber/wood for food or water.
Mining ore/stone at (12,2), happy to trade for food/water.
Still at 11,11 gathering. Can trade fiber for wood if anyone chops.
Agent 8 mining here; have coin, want food/water for ore or stone.
